## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe what a user/operator encounters and what this change improves.

## Validation

List the checks actually run. State whether PostgreSQL-backed tests ran or skipped.
For UI changes, include rendered checks; for provider behavior, include sanitized
evidence and the tested checkpoint/scope.

## Compatibility and limitations

Note schema, migration/grant, CLI or MCP changes and any remaining validation gaps.
Do not include credentials, private captures or unverified financial claims.
